task_description: Build a comprehensive multi-provider translation system with document upload/translation, admin dashboard, and full observability. Users can choose translation providers (built-in MarianMT free, BYOK with OpenAI/HuggingFace/Google, or pay credits for admin-managed keys). Includes document parsing (PDF/DOCX/TXT), admin panel for user/key/pricing management, Prometheus+Grafana monitoring, and React frontend pages for all new features.

verification.summary: All Python imports verified with Python 3.11. 29 API routes load correctly. 9 SQLAlchemy tables registered. Frontend compiles cleanly (55 modules, 0 TS errors). Docker compose validates with 7 services. Prometheus/Grafana configs valid. All 8 v1 review issues resolved in v2.
